title: Financing Documentation Charge on Vehicle Purchase Agreements Orders
content:
**Charge.** For a signed order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements that is not an exchange replacement, an order financed through Kestrel Auto Finance carries a financing documentation charge, which is added to the documentation fee. It is read from the order's contract in Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts: its tier, and whether the verifications the approval requires before signing (the approval's stipulations) are completed.

| Order's Kestrel Auto Finance contract | Financing documentation charge |
|---|---|
| at Kestrel Finance Tier C, Tier D or Tier E, and the verifications the approval requires before signing are not yet completed | $95.00 (the unverified-stipulation charge) |
| financed through Kestrel Auto Finance in any other case | $45.00 (the standard financing documentation charge) |
| not financed through Kestrel Auto Finance | none |

**Combinations.**

| Tier | Verifications completed | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Tier E, Tier D or Tier C | no | $95.00 |
| Tier E, Tier D or Tier C | yes | $45.00 |
| Tier B, Tier A or Tier A+ | either | $45.00 |
| no Kestrel Auto Finance contract (cash or outside lender) | — | none |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Finance Tier D contract whose required verifications are still outstanding adds $95.00; once the contract's required verifications are recorded as completed, the same order would carry $45.00.
